turn: The access request scope validation is finished. I added a test in tests/test_request_scope.py that builds a request for study ONCO-12 under approval CE-2026-014, which only covers CARDIO-07. It asserts that check_request_scope raises a ValueError. That test is the only change to the scope check in this commit, so the validation code itself is unchanged. I haven't run the test suite in this session, so the new test hasn't been confirmed passing. In the same commit I also made a small unplanned fix. While I was in the test file, I noticed the imports weren't in a consistent order, and I tidied them. Next I will start "Consent filter as SQL view".
